name: BACH_0307
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal alone, and the input looks typical. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 93%, InSitu 6% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.98 / 16th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↓ invasive · Prominent benign stroma, associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scores high, but failed spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 1) · context · Below typical; descriptive only [F4] · Weak
- **Neoplastic nuclei** (regions 0, 2, 4) · context · Only 3 found; flagged insufficient · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu, the runner-up (6%), is correct; neighbor BACH_0043 is InSitu and very similar.
- Tumor nuclei were too few in the 3 sampled regions to judge.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 3**: Look for atypical cells confined within ducts (concept spot check 12/20).
2. **Region 1**: Confirm stroma is benign; it also scores highest for tumor-infiltrating stroma.
3. **Regions 0, 7, 11**: Verify normal lobules; this concept failed its spot check.
